## Why

ADR-157 put every build-time figure in one package; this row lands the
other half (K13 W1 FIG-01b). The dossier bipartite network and the
entity radial ego need deterministic layouts — K2 §6.3 pins the
licence: a BSD/OSI-compatible layout, **never** the GPL `igraph` wheel.
Caps (K6 §6.2) must degrade honestly — a figure that silently drops
nodes reads as a figure that has none. Legends must come from
`lexicon.json` (SIG-UI-061) listing only the symbols drawn, or
one-meaning-per-symbol (SIG-UI-133) breaks. Every visual needs an
accessible table twin (SIG-UI-131) and must leak no per-area data
(SIG-UI-134).

## What lands

- **`exports/src/exports/figures/graph_model.py`** — the
  `sig.figure-kit-graph/1` + `sig.figure-kit-chart/1` plain-data input
  contracts, typed nodes/edges (entity kind, relation/access kind,
  currency, date, `sources`/`claim_ids` provenance), result metadata
  (`sig.figure-kit-meta/1`) and the caps: `NODE_CAP = 60`,
  `SIDE_CAP = 20`, `EGO_CAP = 20`. Malformed input is refused,
  never partially rendered.
- **`layout.py`** — the deterministic layout wrapper: closed-form
  two-column bipartite (anchors left, counterparties right; narrow
  stacks anchors above counterparties) and radial ego (entity centred,
  neighbours on a circle grouped by relation sector). Ordering is
  fully specified by `(group ordinal, label, id)` — no iterative
  solver, no force simulation, no PRNG — so output is byte-identical
  by construction. **No third-party dependency**: implemented in-repo,
  satisfying K2 §6.3's licence pin strictly; `igraph` is never
  imported (asserted in tests).
- **`legend.py`** — legends generated from `web/src/lib/lexicon.json`
  listing **only the encodings the figure emitted** (`fill:*`,
  `line:*`, `kind:*`, `marker:contested`, `currency:muted`,
  `series:<n>`, `absence:*`), carrying the lexicon's own
  `interimLegendLine` wording in lexicon-declared order; an unbound
  token fails the build.
- **`network_figure.py`** — bipartite dossier networks and radial ego
  figures: caps degrade by spec-declared `group_by` grouping (group
  nodes carry labels + member ids in the table twin, edges unioned,
  `group_actions` in metadata); a spec still over-cap after grouping
  **refuses** — no silent pruning, no ranking semantics. Compound
  path per edge class (K6 §6.3); every drawn node carries a
  root-relative link; historical/undated edges render muted with the
  currency state named in `<desc>` and metadata.
- **`chart.py`** — bar, strip, stacked-bar and timeline emitters.
  Chart kind, dates, values and series shape are validated; other
  kinds (pie, scatter, …) and malformed/undated events refuse named.
  Same-day strip events stack into distinct lanes; series use the
  shared `dataHue` token only.
- **Variants + twins + print** — `StaticFigureResult` carries `svg` +
  `svg_narrow` (720/360 px; narrow truncates visible labels with full
  text retained in `<title>`); every result ships
  `table_columns`/`table_rows` twins (stable columns, links,
  provenance fields — never `data-*`); `epistemic.css` `@media print`
  keeps every `.sig-fig*` figure `break-inside: avoid` and
  greyscale-safe with hatches/dashes/`≠` preserved.
- **CLI** — `sig-exports figure network|ego|chart` + `--out-narrow`;
  `map|locator|sprite` unchanged; `--meta`/`--standalone` preserved;
  refusals exit 4 with no partial output.
- **ADR-226** — records the owned decisions: in-repo deterministic
  layouts (vs vendoring a BSD package), caps→grouping→refuse,
  lexicon-generated legends, table-twin placement, wide/narrow + print
  posture. Extends ADR-157 — the kit stays one package.

## Tests

- `tests/exports/test_figure_kit_graphs.py` (**36**): graph/chart
  schema + malformed inputs; deterministic bipartite/ego layouts;
  caps and honest grouping (over-cap refuses); compound edge paths;
  legend only-present + lexicon ordering + fail-closed bindings;
  chart kinds + validation refusals (pie, undated, bad series);
  same-day strip lanes; wide/narrow variants + label truncation;
  table twins; `role="img"`/`<title>`/`<desc>`/`aria-labelledby`;
  serializer CSP legs; byte-determinism; CLI verbs + refusal exit 4;
  no `igraph` import.
- `web/tests/unit/figure-classes.test.ts` (**3**): graph/chart/legend/
  node/edge/axis/table classes ⊆ lexicon + styled; marker classes
  documented; reserved disagreement hue only on the contested class.
